name: DF-D1 Duo-Flechette Rifle
description: The DF-D1 Duo-Flechette Rifle was a type of flechette launcher produced by Salus Corporation, who took inspiration from Golan Arms' FC-1 flechette launcher. Salus's goal for designing the DF-D1 was to reduce the FC-1 to a rifle-sized platform. As a result, the DF-D1 possessed twin canisters of needlelike flechettes, which would detonate and create a cloud of fast-moving razor-sharp debris.
